mappings.key_fact: Order promised in 2 days, delivered on day 6 due to warehouse dispatch delay at WH-07; customer complaint filed.
Delivery 4 days late; repeat complaint from SMB customer citing competitor's 2-day express performance.
Enterprise customer explicitly stated three of last five deliveries missed SLA in June, leading to churn and volume migration to competitor; customer requests reliable 3-day SLA.
Enterprise customer cited June delivery misses on 4 POs as reason for evaluating competitor's express program; renewal at risk.
WH-07 conveyor failure on June 25 caused 60% throughput reduction and staffing shortage of 14 pickers; ops team expects SLA breaches on North-West lanes until resolved.
